title: Amazon PPC Lead Generator
description: A fully automated lead qualification system that scrapes agency websites to detect outdated tech stacks, filtering high-value prospects.

full_details.problem: The client was spending 15 hours/week manually checking agency websites to find sales targets. They needed a way to automate this research without hiring a VA.
full_details.solution: I designed an n8n workflow that ingests domain lists, scrapes HTML content, and uses Regex logic to identify outdated WordPress versions. Qualified leads are auto-saved to a CRM.
full_details.result: Reduced manual research time by 95%. The client now receives a qualified list of leads every Monday morning automatically.

title: LinkedIn Data Extraction Tool
description: A custom tool designed to securely fetch public profile data by reverse engineering internal API endpoints, bypassing standard bot detection.

full_details.problem: Standard scraping tools are often blocked by LinkedIn's anti-bot measures. I needed a method to gather public data reliably for analysis.
full_details.solution: I reverse-engineered the internal API calls made by the browser and built a Chrome Extension that piggybacks on valid session tokens to fetch data safely.
full_details.result: Achieved a 0% ban rate while gathering data at scale, demonstrating the ability to work with complex, secured APIs.

title: AI Invoice Processing System
description: An intelligent document processing agent that extracts financial data from PDF invoices and updates accounting records automatically.

full_details.problem: A small business owner was drowning in PDF invoices, manually typing data into Excel. OCR tools failed on handwritten notes.
full_details.solution: I built an n8n workflow using OpenAI's Vision model. It reads the PDF as an image, extracts 'Vendor', 'Date', and 'Total', and formats it strictly as JSON.
full_details.result: 100% accuracy on typed invoices and 90% on handwritten ones. Completely removed manual data entry from the owner's workload.
